% hyphenation — words that TeX breaks at line ends, beside words whose hyphen is theirs.
%
% A narrow measure makes TeX hyphenate long words: this build breaks "extensive",
% "configuration" and "implementation" at line ends. The gold file holds each one
% whole, because the hyphen at a line end is the typesetter's and not the author's.
% The compounds "well-known" and "long-standing" keep their hyphens. Neither falls at
% a line end here, which is the ambiguous case, so this fixture does not cover it.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{lmodern}
\usepackage[paperwidth=3.2in,paperheight=4in,margin=0.4in]{geometry}
\pagestyle{empty}
\begin{document}
The well-known problem with extensive documentation is that its configuration
sections drift from the implementation, and a long-standing remedy is to generate
those sections automatically from the implementation itself, so that documentation
and configuration cannot disagree.
\end{document}
